legacy.claim: The dissipative parameter that sets the dipole also sets a first-order self-acceleration \(\mathbf{a}_{\rm self}=-\tfrac{2}{3}\Gamma\,(\lvert W\rvert/Mc^2)\,\mathbf{w}\) of every gravitationally bound body along its substrate-relative velocity, so a galactic dipole \(A_1\) at radius \(R\) forces \(a_{\rm self}=\tfrac{4A_1}{3R}(\lvert W\rvert/M)(\beta_{\rm b}/\beta_{\rm gal})\) on every other body
